name: Ventas/Tickets — admin registra ticket multi-producto y ve líneas en la tabla
description: Un admin entra a Ventas/Tickets, registra una venta con al menos dos productos, y ve esas líneas en la tabla con ID, cantidad, totales y método de pago.

planSteps.description: Sign in with the admin email and password configured for this project
Open the Ventas/Tickets section from the sidebar navigation
Verify the Ventas/Tickets page shows a sales table with columns for ID, Producto, Cantidad, SUBT, Descuento, Comisión, Total, Fecha, Método de pago, En corte, and Pagado
Add a first product line with quantity at least 1
Add a second product line for a different product with quantity at least 1
Choose a payment method and save the sale
Verify the sales table shows new line rows for both products of the saved ticket, including matching quantities and a shared ticket ID, without remaining stuck on the create form
